subject.title: fix: fail release performance when reports do not publish

question: Should OpenClaw replace the old CLAWGRIT_REPORTS_TOKEN publisher with this artifact-consuming ClawSweeper App-token publisher and fail scheduled/profile=release runs when publication fails?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but it changes release automation credentials and fail-closed operator behavior, which should be accepted by a maintainer rather than inferred from green CI alone.

options.title: Land the App-token publisher
options.body: Accept the scoped App-token boundary and fail-closed release behavior using the live run proof already attached to the PR.

options.title: Pause for credential rollout
options.body: Hold merge until the App installation and secret ownership are reconfirmed outside the PR evidence.

options.title: Keep advisory publishing
options.body: Reject the fail-closed policy and leave release operators with artifact-only diagnostics when report publication fails.

recommendation.title: Land the App-token publisher
recommendation.body: Accept the scoped App-token boundary and fail-closed release behavior using the live run proof already attached to the PR.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the only strong current-history owner for the workflow and the PR's live release proof.
